name: primal-P-v1
purpose: Lemma M certificate on the primal region P = {r in [0,3], w in [1/5, 40], phi in [0, 31416/5000]} (31416/5000 > 2 pi >= theta1(r)). Every leaf box must be INFEAS, SGE (S > T on the whole box) or DPOS (dS/dr > 0 at fixed (w, phi) on the whole box). P is downward closed in r at fixed (w, phi), which the continuation argument requires.
split_rule: split_dim = argmax_i width_i * weight_i (ties -> lowest index), bisect at the exact rational midpoint; child 0 = lower half, child 1 = upper half

tests.INFEAS: phi_lo > pi and r_lo > 0 and g_{r_lo}(phi_lo) > 1 (ball arithmetic at the exact corner point); then phi > theta1(r) for all box points
tests.SGE: a1 > 0 and G > 0 on the box: first naive ball evaluation, else mean-value form G(m) + sum_j dG_j(B)[-h_j, h_j] with dG_j(B) from first-order acb jets
tests.DPOS: a0, a1, a2 > 0 (naive) and D > 0: naive, else mean-value form

arithmetic: python-flint 0.9.0 arb/acb ball arithmetic, 128-bit working precision; box ranges enter as arb(lo).union(arb(hi)) from exact rationals; midpoints as arb((lo+hi)/2)
termination: depth-first per initial cell; a box at depth 40 without outcome is a FAIL leaf; eval_cap stops the run without conclusion
outputs: primal.json (counts by outcome, depth histogram, fails, DPOS bounding box, sha256 of leaf lines) and leaves.txt.gz (cell, path, outcome per leaf, DFS order) for check_cover_v1.py
